result.instructions: Series I savings bond rates from TreasuryDirect. The rate for I bonds bought November 1, 2026 to April 30, 2027 is 5.51 percent (fixed 1.40 percent, semiannual inflation 2.04 percent), announced after most model training data. Every older bond has its own fixed rate and changes rate every 6 months from its issue month; use get_i_bond_rate_for_issue_date for "what is my I bond earning now".

tools.name: get_current_i_bond_rate
tools.title: Get current I bond rate
tools.description: Current Series I savings bond composite rate, fixed rate and semiannual inflation rate for new purchases, read at call time from the TreasuryDirect "I bonds interest rates" page with the built-in rate chart as fallback. November 2026 to April 2027: 5.51 percent with a 1.40 percent fixed rate. Also returns the next announcement date and the $10,000 limit, 12-month hold and 3-month penalty rules.

tools.name: get_i_bond_rate_for_issue_date
tools.title: Get I bond rate for an issue date
tools.description: For an I bond bought in a given month: its fixed rate, the composite rate it earns in the current (or given) 6-month period, the months its rate changes, whether it can be cashed and the penalty, and every rate period since issue. Computed from the TreasuryDirect rate chart effective November 1, 2026.

issue_month.description: Issue month of the bond as YYYY-MM, for example "2023-01". The issue date is the first of the month you bought it.

as_of_month.description: Month to evaluate, YYYY-MM. Default: the current month.

annotations.title: I bond rate by issue date

tools.name: estimate_i_bond_value
tools.title: Estimate I bond value
tools.description: Estimate what I bonds are worth for an issue month and purchase amount at the start of a month: value with all interest and the redemption value after the 3-month penalty for bonds under 5 years. Uses semiannual compounding per $25 with the TreasuryDirect rates. An estimate; Treasury values can differ by cents.

issue_month.description: Issue month of the bond as YYYY-MM, for example "2023-01". The issue date is the first of the month you bought it.

amount.description: Purchase price in dollars, for example 10000.

as_of_month.description: Month to evaluate, YYYY-MM. Default: the current month.

tools.name: calculate_i_bond_composite_rate
tools.title: Calculate I bond composite rate
tools.description: Apply the Treasury formula fixed + 2 x semiannual inflation + fixed x semiannual inflation, rounded to 0.01 percent with a floor of zero. Use it for rate predictions.

fixed_rate.description: Fixed rate in percent, for example 1.4.

semiannual_inflation_rate.description: Semiannual inflation rate in percent, for example 2.04.

tools.name: get_i_bond_rate_history
tools.title: Get I bond rate history
tools.description: Fixed rate for new bonds, semiannual inflation rate and composite rate for every May and November announcement since September 1998, newest first, from the TreasuryDirect rate chart.

limit.description: How many announcements, newest first. Default 20.

content.text:
I bonds bought from November 2026 through April 2027 earn 5.51% a year for their first 6 months: a 1.40% fixed rate that lasts for the life of the bond plus 2.04% semiannual inflation rate. Treasury sets the next rates on May 1, 2027. Limit $10,000 in electronic I bonds per Social Security number per calendar year, $25 minimum, held at least 12 months, last 3 months of interest lost if cashed before 5 years.
